Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory463.jpg'}
{1: 'Conference Room', 2: 'Star of Life'}
{2: 'Conference Room, Star of Life.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "—You all did great with that CPR exercise just now. Everyone's getting a gold star as a reward.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'Next up is our last course for today: mock consultations.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'At these words, the children seated in front of Wanshi cheer immediately. A single gold star that represents their perfect score is more than enough to keep them happy for a long time.'}
{2: 'Now, all trainee doctors, please take your seats.', 3: '12'}
{2: 'I will now hand out your gold stars.', 3: '13'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child A', 3: 'Wow, what a pretty star! Thank you, Commandant!', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Child B', 3: 'Idiot! Who are you calling "Commandant"? Dr. Wanshi said everyone here is a professional doctor today, remember? It should be Dr. 【kuroname】! You\'re so unprofessional!', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child C', 3: 'Exactly! Hehe, thank you for handing out the stars, Dr. 【kuroname】!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Being in such a warm and relaxed environment, you find yourself smiling as brightly as the children. Wanshi watches as the kids gather around you, a faint smile also tugging at his lips.'}
{3: 'It seems his decision to bring you along to this children medical education event was the right call.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Alright, now that everyone has their stars, we can begin the consultations. First, we'll do a group demonstration together. After that, you can all return to your seats to practice and complete your assignments.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Now, who wants to play the patient? Raise your hand if you'd like to volunteer.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'The children do not respond with the same enthusiasm as before this time. They exchange glances with one another guiltily as Wanshi watches them in silence, patiently waiting for them to come to a decision.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child A', 3: "...Do you think Dr. Wanshi will say yes? What if he doesn't agree?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child B', 3: 'He won\'t mind, right? Besides, "they" are all set up. Just give it a shot! You go first!', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The children push a boy in the front row forward. He looks down, clutching at the hem of his shirt and muttering to himself before finally gaining the courage to look up at Wanshi.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child A', 3: 'D-Dr. Wanshi! We all want to get to work as soon as possible, so... can we skip being patients this time?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Oh? But then we won't have any patients. What should we do about that?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child A', 3: "We've thought of that already! Just come take a look with Dr. 【kuroname】 and you'll see!", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory524.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory524.jpg'}

{3: 'They eagerly pull the two of you toward the conference room set up for the mock consultations. The chairs have all been moved up to the table, while the once-empty surface is now completely covered with stuffed animals.'}

{3: "Following the children's excited voices, you and Wanshi approach the table to examine these new patients they have prepared. Wanshi picks up one of the stuffed toys, a faint smile appearing on his face."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'So many "patients" are waiting for us. In that case, let me demonstrate first, then I\'ll leave the hands-on practice to you.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Though it seems our patients haven't lined up yet, who should we see first...?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child A', 3: "We know!!! The snow owl Dr. 【kuroname】's holding!!!", 4: '1'}
{3: "All the children's eyes turn to the snow owl plushie in your hands. Its black eyepatch and its drowsy yet sharp gaze look unmistakably familiar."}
{2: 'This plushie looks a lot like Wanshi.', 3: '65', 4: 'This is straight-up Wanshi.', 5: '65'}

{3: 'Wanshi recalls the time before the event began when he was exchanging letters with the children. The moment they started casually asking about his favorite animal, he had a hunch this would happen.'}
{3: 'Wanshi takes the plushie from your hands with a knowing smile, delighted by the carefully prepared gift and a clumsy yet earnest performance by the children.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'Having a doctor treat himself... might not be the wisest idea.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child A', 3: "No, no, it's fine! Trust us, Dr. Wanshi, this is definitely a great idea! The reason is, uh... well, hmm... I don't think I can come up with one.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Child B', 3: '—Oh, I\'ve got it! Didn\'t they say... "Physician, heal thyself"? So it\'s important to treat yourself!', 4: '2'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Child C', 3: "We saw that saying... in a book your sister had hidden last time! But she was acting really weird... She snatched the book away the moment we found it, and she wouldn't let us see it no matter what...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: '...Pfft. What a bunch of rascals.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Wanshi shakes his head with a helpless smile, but he does not refuse the children's request. Gently setting the plushie down on the table, he puts on his stethoscope and prepares to begin."}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Alright then, let's begin our first mock consultation. Dr. 【kuroname】, would you mind assisting me? You'll be in charge of recording symptoms and treatment notes.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Of course not. Leave it to me.', 3: '87', 4: 'No problem. Happy to help.', 5: '87'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "First, let's record the patient's information. We have a male patient with the surname Wan, age 20.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Next, we'll perform a routine auscultation. Now then, our little trainees, do you remember the proper steps? You can call out the answers for this part.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Children', 3: 'Heart rhythm... heart rate... pulse force, and any abnormal sounds!', 4: '1', 5: '2', 6: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Very good. We'll proceed with the examination following those steps.", 4: '1'}
{3: "His slender fingers grasp one end of the stethoscope, guiding it across the snow owl plushie's soft white fur gently."}

{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Patient's heart rhythm is normal... heart rate is normal, pulse force readings are within normal range, and no abnormal sounds detected. Overall cardiac condition is healthy.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "However, these are just the basic indicators. If you want to become excellent doctors, I suggest listening more carefully to your patients' feelings and needs so you can provide more thorough care instructions.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'How exactly...?', 3: '107', 4: "Why don't you demonstrate, Dr. Wanshi?", 5: '107'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'Now, suppose this "patient" confides in us that his sleep quality has been poor, what advice should we give him as his doctor?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Wanshi pauses there. The children are raising their hands eagerly, but he waves them down, as this is not a question they need to answer in class.'}

{2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'Maybe we can suggest improving the sleep environment: soundproofing, temperature and lighting control, and so on. So, consider this your assignment alongside the upcoming mock consultation.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Alright, that concludes the demonstration. Let's return to your seats and begin your mock exercises.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The children file out in a clamor, eager to put their best work into the assignment. Only the two "doctors" remain in the now quiet room and continue to treat their "patient."'}
{2: 'Should we continue the consultation?', 3: '120'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'Sure. We haven\'t finished examining our "patient" yet, but we can treat him right now. My advice for him would be... create a better sleep environment by improving his sense of security.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'He can try keeping a personal belonging from someone close to him and letting the familiar scent soothe his nerves. Or... he can simply find and sleep next to that person.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: '—Like this.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Wanshi reaches over and picks up a gray bird plushie. The children probably could not find the exact plushie they wanted, so they put a silver necklace labeled "Gray Raven" on it to make sure it would be recognizable.'}
{3: 'Wanshi sets the two plushies side by side and nestles them together, as if they are sharing a pillow for the night and drifting off into sweet dreams.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "The sleep issue has been addressed, but it seems our patient has a more pressing concern. Let's hear what it is.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: '"Doctor, I think something\'s wrong with my heart. Whenever I see a certain person, my heart starts racing uncontrollably."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: '"But when I can\'t see that person, it feels like a piece of my heart is missing. It feels empty. Incomplete."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: '"I can\'t quite identify what kind of heart condition this is. Please prescribe the appropriate treatment for me, Doctor."', 4: '1'}
{3: "Wanshi's hand remains pressed on the snow owl, but his eyes are now focused on you, his gaze holding something tender and ineffable."}
{3: 'He does not hold that gaze for long, yet somehow it is enough to make you feel completely exposed under its intensity.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wanshi', 3: "This condition is actually quite easy to treat. The remedy is simple... Go find the person who's been on your mind.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "Then, tell that person everything you've been wanting to say, honestly and faithfully.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Will that cure it?', 3: '144', 4: 'And then?', 5: '144'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'Well... you might not fully recover at all. This particular heart condition may spread instead, making someone else feel the same way.', 4: '1'}
{2: "That doesn't sound like a cure.", 3: '147', 4: "Isn't that a little unprofessional, Dr. Wanshi?", 5: '147'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: '...Of course not.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Wanshi steps forward and takes your hand, guiding you closer to the consultation desk. Your fingers intertwine as both your hands come to rest on the snow owl.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3Loading.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '1'}

{3: 'Thump-thump. Thump-thump. It is strange how it works: it is not something you can physically feel, yet somehow you both sense a warm, affectionate heartbeat connecting you through the words he is about to say.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3Loading.prefab', 5: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "There's an old Kowloong saying: Matters of the heart can only be treated by the heart. That's why this is the most fitting remedy.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'As for a so-called "cure"... perhaps the patient never wanted to lose this feeling through treatment in the first place. It might just be an excuse... a reason to see you.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: "We've wrapped up all the activities for today's workshop. Now we just need to wait for the children to finish their assignments on their own. So...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wanshi', 3: 'For the rest of our time here... let me be a little selfish and have you all to myself, 【kuroname】.', 4: '1'}
